items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: we played in the back end of the saloons and things with he and...Fatty Arbuckle and his partners, and we was the musicians

ctx.x: Did you start to say Prescott?

No, it was...Douglas, I think. Anyway (you got it on?), we played in the back end of the saloons and things with he and...Fatty Arbuckle and his partners, and we was the musicians, and we played in several sporting houses doing the...uh...Arizona, just piano and drums, which was a great novelty in those days, and we were hired by everybody where we just couldn't fill the engagements because it was a novelty, piano and drums, and my brother was a good piano player. So then we organized our own shows, and we had…
What kind of music were you playing? Do you remember any of the tunes?
